the integration of feature, model, and semantic information in video retrieval is a challenging problem, but that it is possible to achieve significant improvement in retrieval performance by integrating these different sources of information.

the development and evaluation of a system for automatic retrieval of video content that is based on the integration of content-based features and models.
developing a content-based retrieval system that integrates features, content-based and model based queries, and relevance feedback.
the development of a system for content-based retrieval of digital video that is based on a combination of low-level feature descriptors and high-level models of video scenes and objects.
